Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual lands within five of the tightest open bin, targeting leftovers near the current minimum, while keeping the mid penalty. This adapts the sweet band to each state, but the target may sit in an awkward range and the band may rarely trigger.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if abs((r - item) - min(bins)) <= 5 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
